title: Box Split
prompt: Split the grid into boxes. Each box has one number, and that many squares.

status.dragOrTap: Drag from corner to corner, or tap two corners.
status.tapOnly: Tap one corner of a box, then the other.
status.secondCorner: Now tap the other corner. Tap the same square for a 1-square box.
status.done: Every square is in a box!

right.title: Grid split!
right.message: Every box has one number and the right number of squares.
right.timed: Every box is right. Your time: {time}.

wrong.title: Not that box
wrong.message: {size} is the right size, but the {area} in row {row}, column {col} does not go there. Try another shape.

refuse.noNumber: That box has no number. Every box needs one number.
refuse.twoNumbers: That box has two numbers. A box holds just one.
refuse.tooBig: That box has {size} squares, but its number is {area}. Make it smaller.
refuse.tooSmall: That box has {size} squares, but its number is {area}. Make it bigger.
refuse.overlaps: That box covers a box you already drew.

single-fit.look: Find a number that has only one box that fits.
single-fit.where: Look at the {area} in row {row}, column {col}. Try each shape with {area} squares. Only one fits.

only-reach.look: Look for an empty square that only one number can reach.
only-reach.where: Only the {area} in row {row}, column {col} can reach the glowing square at {square}. Its box must cover it.

overlap.look: Look for a number whose boxes all cover the same squares.
overlap.where: Every box for the {area} in row {row}, column {col} covers the glowing squares. No other number can use them.

hint.worked: The {area} in row {row}, column {col} gets a box {h} rows tall and {w} wide: {h} × {w} = {area}. Draw it where it glows.
hint.workedOne: The 1 in row {row}, column {col} is a box on its own. Tap it twice.

demo.intro: Every number needs a box. The number says how many squares.
demo.one: A 1 is a box on its own. Tap it twice.
demo.three: This 3 needs 3 squares. Drag from corner to corner.
demo.two: This 2 takes the square below it.
demo.last: The last 1 is a box on its own.
demo.done: Every square is in a box. Done!
